other_conditions: Applicant must be a resident of West Bengal
Applicant must be enrolled under the "Swasthya Sathi" scheme

Applicant must not be a permanent or retired government employee of Central/State Government, statutory bodies, government undertakings, panchayats, municipal corporations/municipalities, local bodies, or teaching and non-teaching staff of government‑aided educational institutions
benefits_summary: Women from SC/ST households receive ₹1,200 per month; women from other categories receive ₹1,000 per month.
documents_required: Self‑attested copies of the required documents
